functions

```{r}

prog_lm <- function(df){
# Initialize an empty list to store results
results_list <- list()
model_list <- list()

# Get unique CellTypes
cell_types <- unique(df$CellType)

# Loop through each CellType
for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  
  # Subset the data for the current CellType
  subset_data <- subset(df, CellType == cell_type)
  
  set.seed(12345)
  # Fit the linear mixed model
  # models with Media alone (not SeqBatch alone or SeqBatch + Media) performed best by AIC
  model <- try(lm(Abundance ~ Group2 * Sex + Media, data = subset_data), silent = TRUE)
  
  # Check if the model fit was successful
  if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
    warning("Model failed to converge for CellType: ", cell_type, " ")
    next  # Skip this iteration if the model didn't converge
  }
  
  model_list[[cell_type]] <- model

  
  ## Estimated marginal means: Group comparisons WITHIN sex
  set.seed(12345)
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Group2 | Sex)
  
  contrasts <- contrast(
      emm,
      method = "pairwise",
      adjust = "none"   # IMPORTANT: we do FDR ourselves
    )

    contrast_df <- as.data.frame(contrasts)

    contrast_df$CellType <- cell_type

    results_list[[cell_type]] <- contrast_df
}

# Combine all results into a single data frame
results_prog <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# FDR correction for the Group2 effect

  results_prog <- results_prog %>%
    group_by(Sex) %>%
    mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
    ungroup()


results_prog  = results_prog %>% mutate(
  psymbol = case_when( p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                       p.value >= 0.001 & p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                       p.value >= 0.01 & p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                       p.value > 0.05 ~ "NS"),
  FDRsymbol = case_when( FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
                       FDR >= 0.001 & FDR < 0.01 ~ "**",
                       FDR >= 0.01 & FDR < 0.05 ~ "*",
                       FDR > 0.05 ~ "NS")
  
)

return(list(
    results = results_prog,
    models = model_list
  ))
}

```

```{r}

Cardiocondition=read_excel("~/CardioCondition.xlsx")


Cardioinfo=Cardiocondition

Cardioinfo$SeqOrder <- as.numeric(Cardioinfo$SeqOrder)
Cardioinfo = Cardioinfo %>% arrange(SeqOrder)


Cardioinfo<- Cardioinfo %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(trimws(.), "")),
         across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "NA")), 
         across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "Inf")),
         across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.), NA, .)),
         across(where(is.numeric), ~ifelse(. == "", NA, as.numeric(.))))

Cardioinfo<- Cardioinfo %>% mutate(
  Group2_sex = case_when(Group == "AA" ~ paste(Sex,"AA", sep = "_"),
                         Group == "B1B1" ~ paste(Sex,"B1B1", sep = "_"),
                    Group == "AB1" ~ paste(Sex,"AB1.B2", sep = "_"),
                    Group == "AB2" ~ paste(Sex,"AB1.B2", sep = "_"),
                    #Group == "AC.D" ~ "AB1.B2",
                    Group == "B1B2" ~ paste(Sex,"B1B2.C.D", sep = "_"),
                    Group == "B1C.D" ~ paste(Sex,"B1B2.C.D", sep = "_"),
                    TRUE ~ Group),
  Group2 = case_when(Group == "AB1" ~ "AB1.B2",
                    Group == "AB2" ~ "AB1.B2",
                    #Group == "AC.D" ~ "AB1.B2",
                    Group == "B1B2" ~ "B1B2.C.D",
                    Group == "B1C.D" ~ "B1B2.C.D",
                    TRUE ~ Group))

info <- Cardioinfo %>%
   select(Code, Patient, Category, Group2, Group2_sex, Time, Infected,Sex, Media, SeqBatch)

sequenced_sample_data = subset(Cardioinfo, !is.na(SeqOrder))
```

```{r}
library("immunedeconv")   
TPMcounts=read.delim("~/Deconv/Cardio_TPM_batch1234.txt",row.names = 1)



design_keep = model.matrix(~ Group2_sex, data = sequenced_sample_data)

library(limma)

corrected_TPM <- removeBatchEffect(
  log2(TPMcounts + 1),
  batch = sequenced_sample_data$SeqBatch,       # Primary batch effect
  batch2 = sequenced_sample_data$Media,             # Secondary batch effect
  design = design_keep            # Protect biological variables
)


corrected_TPM <- 2^corrected_TPM -1

corrected_TPM <- round(corrected_TPM, 6)
corrected_TPM[corrected_TPM < 0] <- 0 #cibersort does this internally anyway so ill do it for xcell and ABIS



#write.table(corrected_TPM, "~/Cardio_TPM_BatchCorrected.txt",sep = "\t")
```

# CIBERSORT

I run cibersortx on <https://cibersortx.stanford.edu/>. I use the LM22 microarray signature matrix. Since my data is from bulk RNAseq, I perform batch correction in B mode using LM22 source GEP file to account for the difference in microarray and RNAseqd data. I run 1000 permutations

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected=read.csv("~/Deconv/CIBERSORTx_batch1234_absolute_corrected.csv") #this was using the batch corrected TPMs

ciber_Abundance_wide=read.csv("~/Deconv/CIBERSORTx_batch1234_absolute.csv") #this is using the non-limma-batch corrected TPMS

ciber_Abundance_wide <- subset(ciber_Abundance_wide, select = -c(RMSE, Correlation, P.value,Absolute.score..sig.score.))

ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected <- subset(ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected, select = -c(RMSE, Correlation, P.value,Absolute.score..sig.score.))


#group some cells to make them more comparable to ABIS and xcell
ciber_Abundance_wide <- ciber_Abundance_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Tcells.CD4.memory = T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + T.cells.CD4.memory.activated,
    NKcells = NK.cells.resting + NK.cells.activated,
    Dendritic.cells = Dendritic.cells.resting + Dendritic.cells.activated,
    Mast.cells = Mast.cells.resting + Mast.cells.activated
  ) %>%
  select(
    -T.cells.CD4.memory.resting, -T.cells.CD4.memory.activated,
    -NK.cells.resting, -NK.cells.activated,
    -Dendritic.cells.resting, -Dendritic.cells.activated,
    -Mast.cells.resting, -Mast.cells.activated,-Macrophages.M0, -Macrophages.M1,  -Macrophages.M2, -T.cells.follicular.helper
  )


ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected <- ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected %>%
  mutate(
    Tcells.CD4.memory = T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + T.cells.CD4.memory.activated,
    NKcells = NK.cells.resting + NK.cells.activated,
    Dendritic.cells = Dendritic.cells.resting + Dendritic.cells.activated,
    Mast.cells = Mast.cells.resting + Mast.cells.activated
  ) %>%
  select(
    -T.cells.CD4.memory.resting, -T.cells.CD4.memory.activated,
    -NK.cells.resting, -NK.cells.activated,
    -Dendritic.cells.resting, -Dendritic.cells.activated,
    -Mast.cells.resting, -Mast.cells.activated,-Macrophages.M0, -Macrophages.M1,  -Macrophages.M2, -T.cells.follicular.helper
  )


cell_types = colnames(ciber_Abundance_wide)[2:ncol(ciber_Abundance_wide)]

ciber_Abundance_wide <- ciber_Abundance_wide %>% 
  rename(Code = Mixture ) %>% 
   left_join(info, by="Code")

ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected <- ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected %>% 
  rename(Code = Mixture ) %>% 
   left_join(info, by="Code")

ciber_Abundance_wide=na.omit(ciber_Abundance_wide)

ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected=na.omit(ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected)


info_length = ncol(info)-1
ciber_cols = ncol(ciber_Abundance_wide)

ciber_Abundance_wide[(ciber_cols-info_length+1):ciber_cols] <- lapply(ciber_Abundance_wide[(ciber_cols-info_length+1):ciber_cols], as.factor)

ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected[(ciber_cols-info_length+1):ciber_cols] <- lapply(ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected[(ciber_cols-info_length+1):ciber_cols], as.factor)


ciber_Abundance_long = ciber_Abundance_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(Code, Patient, Category, Group2, Group2_sex, Time, Infected,Sex, Media, SeqBatch), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Abundance")



ciber_Abundance_long_corrected = ciber_Abundance_wide_corrected %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(Code, Patient, Category, Group2,Group2_sex, Time, Infected,Sex, Media, SeqBatch), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Abundance")




#progression


tciber_long_prog_all= subset(ciber_Abundance_long, Infected=="Pos" & Time=="1" &(Group2 %in% c("AA","AB1.B2","B1B1","B1B2.C.D")))

ciber_long_prog_all_corrected= subset(ciber_Abundance_long_corrected, Infected=="Pos" & Time=="1" &(Group2 %in% c("AA","AB1.B2","B1B1","B1B2.C.D")))




```

## Progressors vs non progressors

linear model adjusting for sequencing batch and media  

Absoluate values allow for comparison of a given cell type across patients (Inter group comparison), but suposedly this can also be used to compare between cell types.

```{r}
ciber_test_prog_all <- prog_lm(tciber_long_prog_all)


ciber_sig_prog_all  = subset(ciber_test_prog_all$results , p.value < 0.05)
knitr::kable(ciber_sig_prog_all)
```

 

```{r}

facet_max <- tciber_long_prog_all%>%
  group_by(CellType, Sex) %>%
  summarise(max_prop = max(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ciber_sig_prog_all <- ciber_sig_prog_all %>%
  filter(FDR <0.05)%>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(contrast, delim = " - ", names = c("group1", "group2"), cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(group1 = paste(Sex, group1, sep = "_"),
         group2 = paste(Sex, group2, sep = "_"),
         FDR.round = round(FDR,3),
         FDR = case_when(FDR < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
                         TRUE ~ as.character(FDR.round)))%>%
left_join(facet_max, by = c("CellType","Sex")) %>%
group_by(CellType,Sex) %>%
 mutate(
    y.position = {
      mp <- unique(max_prop)   # ensure it's length 1
      seq(mp * 1.05, mp * 1.2, length.out = n())
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

 

```{r, fig.height=8.2, fig.width = 15.5}




ggplot(ciber_long_prog_all_corrected, aes(fill=Group2_sex,x=Group2_sex, y=Abundance)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 1, alpha = 0.8, aes(color = Group2_sex)) +
  geom_boxplot(position="dodge", width=0.75, outlier.size = 0, alpha = 0.6)+
  scale_color_manual(values=phenocols_sex_dark )+
  scale_fill_manual(values=phenocols_sex )+
 theme_classic()+
    facet_wrap(~CellType, scales="free_y")+
   scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))+
  stat_pvalue_manual(ciber_sig_prog_all, label = "FDR", size =2) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size =7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size =6, color="black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size =6, color="black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size =7, color="black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size =0, color="black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(11, "pt"))


 ggsave(filename="~/Deconv/cibersort_all.pdf",width = 13, height=8.2) 

```
 

# X cell

array = false when RNAseq

expected cell types is good to define, so i removed ("Common lymphoid progenitor", "Common myeloid progenitor","Cancer associated fibroblast", "Granulocyte-monocyte progenitor", "Hematopoietic stem cell", "Macrophage", "Macrophage M1", "Macrophage M2") since these should not be in the peripheral blood

i think im also going to remove the following cell types to better align with cibersort and abis - b cell, class-switched memory B cell, - "T cell CD8+ effector memory", "T cell CD8+ central memory", "T cell CD8+ naive", - "T cell CD4+ (non-regulatory)", "T cell CD4+ central memory", "T cell CD4+ effector memory","T cell CD4+ Th1", "T cell CD4+ Th2", -"Myeloid dendritic cell activated",

```{r}
set.seed(12345)
xcelltypes <- c( "T cell CD4+ memory", 
"T cell CD4+ naive", "T cell CD8+", "Myeloid dendritic cell",  
"Eosinophil", "Mast cell", "B cell memory", "Monocyte", "B cell naive", "Neutrophil", 
"NK cell",  "Plasmacytoid dendritic cell", "B cell plasma", 
"T cell gamma delta",  "T cell regulatory (Tregs)")
#"T cell NK"

xcell=immunedeconv::deconvolute(TPMcounts, "xcell", arrays = FALSE, expected_cell_types = xcelltypes)

txcell<-as.data.frame(t(xcell[-1]))
colnames(txcell) <- xcell$cell_type

txcell <- txcell %>% 
   rownames_to_column("Code") %>% 
   left_join(info, by="Code")

txcell=na.omit(txcell)
txcell_long = txcell %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(Code, Patient, Category, Group2, Group2_sex, Time, Infected, Sex, Media, SeqBatch), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Abundance")




xcell_corrected=immunedeconv::deconvolute(corrected_TPM, "xcell", arrays = FALSE, expected_cell_types = xcelltypes)

txcell_corrected<-as.data.frame(t(xcell_corrected[-1]))
colnames(txcell_corrected) <- xcell_corrected$cell_type

txcell_corrected <- txcell_corrected %>% 
   rownames_to_column("Code") %>% 
   left_join(info, by="Code")

txcell_corrected=na.omit(txcell_corrected)
txcell_corrected_long = txcell_corrected %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(Code, Patient, Category, Group2,Group2_sex,  Time, Infected, Sex, Media, SeqBatch), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Abundance")
```

# ABIS

```{r}
abis=immunedeconv::deconvolute(TPMcounts, "abis", arrays = FALSE) # arrays = false since RNAseq
abis_corrected=immunedeconv::deconvolute(corrected_TPM, "abis", arrays = FALSE) # arrays = false since RNAseq


tabis<-as.data.frame(t(abis[-1]))
tabis_corrected<-as.data.frame(t(abis_corrected[-1]))

colnames(tabis) <- abis$cell_type
colnames(tabis_corrected) <- abis_corrected$cell_type


tabis <- tabis %>% 
   rownames_to_column("Code") %>% 
   left_join(info, by="Code")

tabis_corrected <- tabis_corrected %>% 
   rownames_to_column("Code") %>% 
   left_join(info, by="Code")

tabis=na.omit(tabis)


tabis_corrected=na.omit(tabis_corrected)


tabis_corrected <- tabis_corrected %>%
  mutate(
    Tcells.CD8 = `T cell CD8+ memory` + `T cell CD8+ naive`,
    Tcell.gamma.delta = `T cell gamma delta VD2` + `T cell gamma delta non-VD2`,
    Monocytes = `Monocyte non-conventional` + `Monocyte conventional`
  ) %>%
  select(
    -`T cell CD8+ memory`,-`T cell CD8+ naive`,
    -`T cell gamma delta VD2` ,-`T cell gamma delta non-VD2`,
   -`Monocyte non-conventional` ,-`Monocyte conventional`, -`T cell MAIT`
    
  )



tabis<- tabis %>%
  mutate(
    Tcells.CD8 = `T cell CD8+ memory` + `T cell CD8+ naive`,
    Tcell.gamma.delta = `T cell gamma delta VD2` + `T cell gamma delta non-VD2`,
    Monocytes = `Monocyte non-conventional` + `Monocyte conventional`
  ) %>%
  select(
    -`T cell CD8+ memory`,-`T cell CD8+ naive`,
    -`T cell gamma delta VD2` ,-`T cell gamma delta non-VD2`,
   -`Monocyte non-conventional` ,-`Monocyte conventional`, -`T cell MAIT`
    
  )


tabis_long = tabis %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(Code, Patient, Category, Group2, Group2_sex, Time, Infected, Sex, Media, SeqBatch), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Abundance")


tabis_long_corrected = tabis_corrected %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(Code, Patient, Category, Group2, Group2_sex, Time, Infected, Sex, Media, SeqBatch), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Abundance")
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width = 13}
  stat_pvalue_manual(abis_sig_prog_all, label = "FDR", size =2) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size =7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size =6, color="black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size =6, color="black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size =7, color="black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size =0, color="black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(11, "pt"))


 ggsave(filename="~/Deconv/abis_all.pdf",width = 12.54, height=7.1)
```
